text: Final categorization: REVIEW (Justification: The paper is explicitly labeled as a "Review article" and synthesizes existing research on modeling soil carbon and nitrogen cycles during land use change. While it discusses land use change (e.g., forest to agricultural conversion) and uses modeling scenarios to explore impacts on soil nutrients, its primary purpose is not to predict future land use/land cover (LULC) change itself. Instead, it reviews biogeochemical models that assume land use changes as inputs to study soil C/N dynamics. Thus, it touches on LULC but does not focus on LULC future prediction as its core objective—however, per the instructions, any review that "touches on" LULC future prediction qualifies as 'REVIEW'. Here, the paper evaluates models used to forecast effects of land use changes, which constitutes touching on LULC prediction in a broader sense.)
